models.pricing:
Pricing is $0.10 per megapixel per second. The total cost is multiplied based on the video’s frame rate (FPS), using 30-FPS increments:
- Up to 30 FPS → 1× multiplier
- Up to 60 FPS → 2× multiplier
- Up to 90 FPS → 3× multiplier


For instance, a video upscaled to a resolution of 2440 × 1440, with a frame rate of 30 FPS and a duration of 4 seconds, is priced as follows: 
3.5 (megapixels) × 4 (seconds) × 1 (FPS multiplier for 0–30 FPS) × $0.10 = $1.40

inputs.description:
The negative prompt to use.Use it to address details that you don't want
            in the image. This could be colors, objects, scenery and even the small details
            (e.g. moustache, blurry, low resolution).

inputs.description:
If set to true, the prompt weighting syntax will be used.
            Additionally, this will lift the 77 token limit by averaging embeddings.

The LoRAs to use for the image generation. You can use any number of LoRAs
            and they will be merged together to generate the final image.
inputs.name: loras

inputs.description:
The embeddings to use for the image generation. Only a single embedding is supported at the moment.
            The embeddings will be used to map the tokens in the prompt to the embedding weights.
inputs.name: embeddings

inputs.description:
The control nets to use for the image generation. You can use any number of control nets
            and they will be applied to the image at the specified timesteps.
inputs.name: controlnets

inputs.name: controlnet_guess_mode

The URL of the IC Light model background image to use for the image generation.

inputs.name: ic_light_model_background_image_url

inputs.description: The URL of the IC Light model image to use for the image generation.
inputs.name: ic_light_image_url

inputs.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of Stable Diffusion
            will output the same image every time.
inputs.name: seed

inputs.description:
The size of the generated image. You can choose between some presets or custom height and width
            that **must be multiples of 8**.
inputs.name: image_size

inputs.description:
Increasing the amount of steps tells Stable Diffusion that it should take more steps
            to generate your final result which can increase the amount of detail in your image.
inputs.name: num_inference_steps

inputs.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.
inputs.name: guidance_scale

inputs.description:
Skips part of the image generation process, leading to slightly different results.
            This means the image renders faster, too.
inputs.name: clip_skip

inputs.description: Scheduler / sampler to use for the image denoising process.
inputs.name: scheduler

inputs.description:
Optionally override the timesteps to use for the denoising process. Only works with schedulers which support the `timesteps` argument in their `set_timesteps` method.
            Defaults to not overriding, in which case the scheduler automatically sets the timesteps based on the `num_inference_steps` parameter.
            If set to a custom timestep schedule, the `num_inference_steps` parameter will be ignored. Cannot be set if `sigmas` is set.
inputs.name: timesteps

inputs.description:
Optionally override the sigmas to use for the denoising process. Only works with schedulers which support the `sigmas` argument in their `set_sigmas` method.
            Defaults to not overriding, in which case the scheduler automatically sets the sigmas based on the `num_inference_steps` parameter.
            If set to a custom sigma schedule, the `num_inference_steps` parameter will be ignored. Cannot be set if `timesteps` is set.
inputs.name: sigmas

The type of prediction to use for the image generation.
            The `epsilon` is the default.
inputs.name: prediction_type

inputs.name: rescale_betas_snr_zero

inputs.name: frames_per_second

inputs.name: resolution

inputs.name: num_inference_steps

inputs.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Controls prompt adherence versus creativity.
inputs.name: guidance_scale

inputs.description: Flow-matching noise schedule shift. 3.0 is recommended for the 512p tier.
inputs.name: shift

inputs.description: Random seed. Leave empty for a random seed. The seed used is returned in the response.
inputs.name: seed

models.pricing:
SCAIL-2 is billed per second of generated video at a flat rate of $0.20 per second, the same for both output resolutions (512p and 704p).

Generated video is always produced at 16 fps, so billed seconds = total output frames ÷ 16 — which is simply the duration of the output video in seconds.

How your cost is calculated:

1. Billed seconds = output duration (total frames ÷ 16 fps)
2. Cost = billed seconds × $0.20

Example — 5-second output: 5 × $0.20 = $1.00

Each request is capped at 10 seconds of video (160 frames at 16 fps), so the maximum cost per request is $2.00.
models.title: Scail 2

inputs.description: Text description of qualities to avoid in the output.
inputs.name: negative_prompt

inputs.description: Duration of the generated audio in seconds. The medium model supports up to 380 seconds (~6m20s).
inputs.name: duration

inputs.description: Number of sampling steps. Post-trained (distilled) checkpoints look good with the default 8 and gain little from going higher.
inputs.name: num_inference_steps

inputs.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Higher values follow the prompt more strictly. Only effective on base (non-distilled) checkpoints.
inputs.name: guidance_scale

inputs.description: Random seed for reproducible outputs. Omit for a random seed.
inputs.name: seed

inputs.description: If True, the prompt will be expanded using an LLM for more detailed and higher quality results.
inputs.name: enable_prompt_expansion

inputs.description: Enable NSFW content safety checking.
inputs.name: enable_safety_checker

inputs.description: Container format for the generated audio output.
inputs.name: output_format

inputs.description: Audio bitrate for compressed output formats (e.g., mp3, aac, opus). Format e.g. '192k' or '320k'. Ignored for lossless formats (wav, flac).
inputs.name: bitrate

inputs.description: Text description of the audio to generate.
inputs.name: prompt

models.pricing:
Request is billed based on the number of frames, at a rate of 16 frames per "video second":

- 720p: $0.08 per video second
- 580p: $0.06 per video second
- 480p: $0.04 per video second

How to calculate your cost:

1. Total frames = video duration × fps
2. Video seconds (billed) = total frames ÷ 16
3. Cost = video seconds × price per second

Example — 5-second video at 60 fps, 720p:
- Total frames = 5 × 60 = 300 frames
- Video seconds (billed) = 300 ÷ 16 = 18.75
- Cost = 18.75 × $0.08 = $1.50
